A Letter
Just for You ♡

💌
To my dearest Faraan, Happy Birthday. ♡ I hope this new year of your life brings you peace, happiness, good health, and beautiful opportunities. I hope you find reasons to smile even on difficult days, and that the things your heart quietly wishes for find their way to you. Thank you for the memories, the laughter, and all the little moments that have found a place in my heart. Whatever this next chapter brings, I genuinely wish the very best for you. Keep growing, keep smiling, and never forget how much goodness you deserve. May this year be gentle with your heart and full of moments worth remembering. Happy Birthday, Faraan. May your wishes come true. ♡ Always with warm wishes, Hadia
♡
